pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark polygonal regions characterized by high-contrast, jagged edge gradients. The geometry features irregular vertices with sharp angularity rather than smooth curves.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways forming a negative-space grid. Junction nodes are clearly defined with frequent tri-axial and quad-axial intersections separating the darker patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane presents a distinct 1D serrated silhouette against the background, showing irregular amplitude and high-frequency peaks from the mid-neck to the shoulder ridge.

other_distinctive_markers: A small avian specimen is perched on the dorsal ridge at the transition between the upper neck and the shoulder area.
